00084 #define PlayBuf_Docs  @param buffer The Buffer to play, this number of channels witll determin the          \
00085                     the number of channels of this PlayBuf.                     \
00086             @param rate   The rate of playback where 1 is normal speed. The may be set to 0 and     \
00087                     the @c offset input can be modulated manually instead (e.g., using the      \
00088                     LoopPoints UGen).                               \
00089             @param trig   A trigger that will send the playbakc head back to the offset. Just       \
00090                     use 0 for normal use.                             \
00091             @param offset A modulatable offset into the Buffer in samples. Cab be used to driver the    \
00092                     Buffer playback manually instead of or in addition to the @c rate input     \
00093             @param loop   A loop flag to indicate the Buffer should loop (1) or just play one-shot (0). \
00094             @param doneAction If looping oid off and the done action is UGen::DeleteWhenDone then this    \
00095                       UGen will fire a delete action when playback reaches the end of the Buffer. \
00096
